user.title: Enea Energy
user.description: Since ~2026-10 eBOK signs in via moja.enea.pl (reCAPTCHA / SMS). Sign in in your browser, then copy EBOK_SESSION from ebok.enea.pl and (recommended) PHPSESSID from moja.enea.pl via DevTools → Application → Cookies. Do not log out. pointOfDeliveryId can be left empty (auto-discovered); for multiple contracts also set current_client_id from …/select-current-client/<UUID>.

data.current_client_id: Optional: client ID from select-current-client/… URL
